diagnosis.summary: The candidate implements a one-shot sequence (period 0) instead of a repeating cycle. Evidence F2 shows the IR expects an action at 190000 ms (180s into the 3-min period), but the candidate only executes once and terminates. The IR requires the body to repeat every 3 minutes indefinitely.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed period to 180000 to match the IR cycle period. Restructured the script to loop indefinitely by removing the final delay and relying on the wrapper's periodic re-execution to repeat the body actions.
